sourceTitle: My Best Peanut Butter Cookie Recipe
sourceText:
My Best Peanut Butter Cookie Recipe
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 27, 2009 - 11:17pm

Ingredients




1 cup White sugar
1 cup Dark brown sugar
1 cup Buttered-flavored Crisco
2 Eggs, beaten
1 cup Crunchy Jif peanut butter, (or creamy can be used)
1 teaspoon Vanilla
2 cups Unbleached white flour
1 teaspoon Baking soda

Preparation

1 Preheat over to 350 degrees. Sift flour and soda together and set aside. 2 Blend sugars and shortening together in mixer. Add peanut butter. Mix well. 3 Blend in eggs and vanilla. Add flour and soda. Mix well. Form into small balls and put on greased cookie sheet. Press each ball with a fork to make indentations in the dough. Bake approx. 4 10 minutes. My kids loved them!
